description: Dynamic attributes of an expanded JSON remaining body include the blocks partial processing took
notes: The spec's partial processing leaves what the schema requested out of the remaining body. With dynamic blocks expanded, hashicorp/hcl answers dynamic attributes processing of the remaining body with every property of the original body (expandBody.JustAttributes in ext/dynblock/expand_body.go doesn't leave out what PartialContent took), and the JSON syntax reads every property as an attribute in dynamic attributes processing, so the properties b and dynamic, which defined the blocks partial processing took, are attributes of the remaining body.
